Name: Azariah, Son of Hoshaiah
Summary: Azariah, son of Hoshaiah, was a captain of the remnant who accused Jeremiah of speaking falsely when Jeremiah told them to stay in Judah, and who led the people to Egypt, carrying Jeremiah and Baruch with them. He is a different man from Azariah, Daniel's companion, whose Babylonian name was Abednego.
KeyStory: Azariah son of Hoshaiah told Jeremiah that he spoke falsely and that Baruch had set him against them, then led the remnant to Tahpanhes in Egypt.
RelatedPeople: Johanan, Son of Kareah; Jeremiah; Baruch
LifeLesson: Blaming the messenger for an unwelcome answer is the last step before disobeying it.
